cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Stay for the Hard Part
cards.instruction: Create increasing moments of emotional honesty to test whether someone remains present and supportive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I wasn't just late to the reunion. Can I tell you?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I saved you a seat beside me. Was it the traffic?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. No. I waited outside for half an hour. Can you hear why?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm here. But I thought you didn't want to sit with me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I wanted that seat. I was afraid you'd be happier without me there. Will you sit beside me now?

mechanism: A manages disclosure like a competent process while increasing honesty to test B's willingness to stay.
confusable: Confession alone differs from progressively testing presence and support after each more difficult admission.
comparison: An anniversary booking conceals doubts about the relationship; reunion avoidance conceals fear of being unwanted.
seedUse: Retain the two escalating admissions, making corrections guide listening without replacing emotional honesty with procedural jargon.
